title: Haathkadi
desc: ACP Suraj, an honest policeman, swears revenge on culprits when his innocent brother is killed. However, he is soon accused of murder and is remanded to prison.

title: Naag Bhoomi
desc: A dangerous criminal who traffics women terrorises a village community that ceremoniously worships a serpentine deity. Soon, an archaeologist gets caught up in the ensuing chaos.

title: Himmatwar
desc: The son of a wealthy man leaves his family post a misunderstanding. Later, when he saves a police officer from an evil man, this results in him earning the latter's wrath.

title: S 3
desc: A police officer is assigned to solve the murder of the police commissioner. However, when he stumbles across a criminal syndicate, he decides to put an end to their tyranny.

title: Hero No. 1
desc: A man disguises as a servant and enters his lover's house to win the approval of her loved ones.
